subject: RE: Synthetix POC - request for larger trial credit + extension
messages:
From: Jordan Ellis <j.ellis@syntheticlabs.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Mar 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Request: trial credit bump + 30 day extension for enterprise POC

Hi Camila —

Thanks for the product walkthrough last week. We’re excited to run a tightly scoped POC with Redwood (SaaS search + summarization across long documents). Two important constraints: we need to exercise a 1M-token context window and our agents will generate at peak about 4–6k TPM each during evaluation. That means token burn is much higher than a typical PLG signup.

Can Redwood temporarily increase our initial trial credits and extend the trial window for 30 days so we can complete the evaluation?

What we’re asking for:
- Increase initial free credits from $1,000 to $12,000 (covers estimated token usage + inference cost)
- Add a 30-day trial extension and ability to top up if POC milestones are met
- Quick PO path if we get to a paid pilot (procurement contact CC’d)

Attached is a short POC plan and a rough TPM/usage estimate. Happy to jump on a 20-minute call if you need more detail.

Jordan Ellis
Head of Integrations, Synthetix Labs
j.ellis@syntheticlabs.com
+1 (415) 555-0142

Attachment: Synthetix_POC_plan.pdf, expected_tpm_estimate.xlsx

From: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Mar 2026 10:04:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Request: trial credit bump + 30 day extension for enterprise POC

Folks — forwarding a POC ask from Synthetix. TL;DR: they want an elevated credit pool to cover high-context runs and a 30-day extension. They anticipate very high TPM during evaluation (4–6k per agent) and will run multi-agent experiments.

Key asks from me:
- Approval to issue a self-serve promo code that grants $12,000 in credits, valid for 45 days (30-day extension + buffer)
- Option to add a conditional top-up (up to +$8k) if they reach milestone A (demo with 1M-context recall)
- If approved, I’ll apply credits and update HubSpot (deal RDW-SX-2026-77).

Any concerns on cost exposure or risk? Rishi — can you confirm the expected unit economics and whether we need to pin them to a specific model variant or limit token-per-request?

Thanks,
Camila Reyes
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
camila@redwood.com
Attachment: Synthetix_POC_plan.pdf

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 03 Mar 2026 11:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: trial credit bump + 30 day extension for enterprise POC

On Mon, Mar 2, 2026 at 10:04 AM Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com> wrote:
> Folks — forwarding a POC ask from Synthetix. TL;DR: they want an elevated credit pool to cover high-context runs and a 30-day extension.

Thanks for the context. Quick technical read: their TPM estimate looks plausible for the stated workload. Cost note: 1M context windows plus high TPM will increase token burn dramatically — estimating $0.10–$0.16 per 1k tokens depending on model family and quantization settings.

Recommendation:
- Approve an initial $10,000 promo credit (self-serve code) with a 45-day TTL (gives them 30 days + a two-week buffer).
- Add a conditional top-up clause: automatic additional $5,000 (manual approval) if they hit milestone A (documented in the POC plan).
- Constrain the promo to specific model variants (e.g., redwood-large-1 or redwood-x-quant) to avoid variant-hopping to much more expensive backends.

I’m comfortable with $10k initial exposure for a named account POC. If Sales wants $12k, we should require procurement PO or card-on-file for top-ups.

Rishi
Applied ML / Inference Optimization
rishi@redwood.com

Camila — please create the promo, apply credits, add the promo code + notes to HubSpot (deal RDW-SX-2026-77) and loop in CS for onboarding.
